mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days because accommodative monetary policy reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth falters.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO growth slows (declines >0.3% in the last month), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST > 600 (thousands of units), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 216.0 signals potential monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 216.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings growth slow.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the last month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth falters.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth (year-over-year) declines >0.5% from the previous quarter, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
